steps.what: Rent, sell or issue sporting equipment and supplies suited to the patron

tasks.design: Retain physical selection, fit checks and equipment handover. Existing item information in the {DOCS} may support the attendant, but this boundary adds no separate paperwork saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment must be found, checked and physically provided to a participant.
tasks.enabler_now: No technical change is needed to the proposed handover process.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the right size and recognising worn or unsuitable equipment.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant checks the actual item and helps the participant use it appropriately.
tasks.altitude: Physical service time and authority remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm the equipment set needed for a group activity

evidence.claim: Physical equipment selection and handover remain human work; no saving is inferred from attraction ticketing capability.

assumptions: Boundary is physical issue and its immediate explanation; payment and separately assigned rental-record tasks are outside it. Do not add an administrative slice to create savings.
Patron supplies the request and size needs; attendant checks available equipment directly. No structured fit or readiness flag is assumed.
Native reference materials remain as today. No new capture, software or upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
If the same handover is also counted in inventory or rental tasks, the roll-up must assign its actual hours once.
unknowns: Whether specialist fit checks are required
research_questions: Which issued items most often need fit adjustment or replacement?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 and R=100 with zero incremental work. Routine supply issue and equipment fitting both retain their physical service time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Operate rides and explain equipment use

steps.what: Operate or drive riding devices and explain their use to patrons

tasks.design: Keep the attendant operating the {OTHER} ride-control equipment and explaining use under approved procedures. Existing automatic interlocks remain part of the equipment and earn no new labour saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Ride operation combines physical controls, observation and immediate patron communication.
tasks.enabler_now: No proposed software change replaces the attendant's work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising unsafe circumstances and responding promptly during operation.
tasks.human_edge: The attendant sees the actual situation and can interrupt operation or clarify an instruction.
tasks.altitude: Operating responsibility and time stay unchanged.

reach.task: Review operator responses to an unusual ride interruption

evidence.claim: The proposed boundary retains the ride operator; existing equipment automation is not a new saving in attendant hours.

assumptions: Boundary is operation and immediate use explanation, not a new maintenance, ticketing or log-writing task.
Operator observes condition and patrons directly under the equipment's approved procedure. No structured all-clear input for a new machine step is assumed.
The existing native control system and interlocks remain as today; no custom code, extra recording or ongoing upkeep is introduced, so incremental work is zero.
Monitoring during operation overlaps general safety duties; a roll-up allocates the actual operating hours once.
research_questions: Which operation exceptions need additional human support?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, incremental=0. Automatic equipment runtime is excluded as a new human saving; operation and explanations retain all attendant time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep hands-on equipment provision and ride operation with the attendant.
reach: Plan suitable equipment sets with a recreation worker
Discuss unusual ride interruptions with an entertainment supervisor
role.ambitious_version: Provide consistent, attentive physical recreation service using approved equipment procedures.
